title: Uncorrected outdoor air intake.
officialText:
The uncorrected outdoor air intake flow rate (V ) shall be determined in ou accordance with Equation 4-6. Σ Σ V = D all zones R P + all zones R A (Equation 4-6) ou p z a z where:

D = Occupant diversity: the ratio of the system population to the sum of the zone populations, determined in accordance with Equation 4-7. Σ D = P / all zones P (Equation 4-7) s z where:

P = System population: The total number of occupants in the area served by the system. For design purposes, P shall be the s s maximum number of occupants expected to be concurrently in all zones served by the system.
